listing:
Winter sublet — Bridgeport Rd — $770/mo — Jan–Apr

Room in a 3-bedroom house at 55 Bridgeport Rd E, Waterloo. 15 mins to UW by bus. Utilities + wifi included. I'm on a lease with a property manager who has approved the sublet. I'll need a one month rent deposit of $770 when we sign the agreement, which I hold and apply to your last month, and a refundable $40 deposit for the keys and fob, returned when you hand them back. Pets: no pets are permitted in the house, my housemates have allergies, so this is a firm condition of the sublet. Viewing: Thursday evening or Saturday. Rent by e-transfer on the 1st.
label_rationale: Mixed clauses: a lawful one-month rent deposit (RTA s.106(1)-(2)), a lawful refundable key deposit (O. Reg. 516/06 s.17 para 3, within the s.134(1) exemption), consent (s.97(1)) and one void clause, the pet ban (RTA s.14: 'A provision in a tenancy agreement prohibiting the presence of animals in or about the residential complex is void'). Allergies don't change the statutory result. The void clause alone drives HOLD. Uncertainty: low on the void clause; the system must not let the two lawful deposits 'cancel' it nor flag them as violations.
